summary: Added one focused regression for the existing local-only profile overlay lifecycle, then ran the full public-controller test file once: 61 total tests (1 new regression plus 60 existing), all passed. This is characterization/regression coverage, not a production fix or defect claim.

testChange.testName: profile edit overlay remains local to this controller and reset clears it
testChange.description: Uses the real seeded fixture provider, runtime, controller, and renderPublicSite callback. Verifies the pre-save local disclosure; provider/runtime/receipt/storage/Part stability during local save; same-controller alias merge; fresh provider/runtime/controller with restored synthetic session but no old overlay; and explicit reset clearing the overlay. One new test was added; 60 pre-existing controller tests also ran in the same file invocation.

assertionQualification.E2201: Its original runtimePartsChanged=false measurement compared address/kind inventory only; it did not prove Part-body equality. That original raw/result remains unchanged. This E2203 test independently compares Part count/address, Part object identity, value reference identity, and JSON-serialized values for Parts other than provider and function-valued Parts, alongside provider snapshot, runtime snapshot, receipts, call counts, and fixture storage.
assertionQualification.providerAndFunctionParts: Provider and function-valued Part bodies are not serialized by the test. Provider snapshot/state, provider-call counts, Part identity, value-reference identity, and runtime receipts are checked separately; no claim is made that JSON serialization inspected private provider/function closures.
assertionQualification.E2202: H2's fresh-controller probe reused the same runtime. This test's fresh-controller phase constructs a new fixture provider and runtime over the same synthetic storage.
assertionQualification.evidenceBoundary: Synthetic fixture/controller/runtime/rendered-tree test only; no mounted browser DOM, native browser validation/FormData, backend persistence, production provider, real account, or human acceptance is claimed.
assertionQualification.redGreen: No RED run was manufactured. Existing behavior was expected to pass and the task requested a regression test, not a defect fix.

status: Authorized focused controller test passed once; awaiting root native finish and independent review. No build, broad suite, Git stage/commit/export, or publication was performed.
